name: Web Access（浏览器自动化）
examples_zh: 搜索并对比三家海外竞品的功能页面
浏览 Reddit 和 LinkedIn 上关于这个问题的公开讨论
登录我授权的管理后台并导出月报，执行前确认
并行研究 5 个公开网站并总结发现
examples_en: Search and compare feature pages from three overseas competitors
Browse public Reddit and LinkedIn discussions about this problem
Log into my authorized admin dashboard and export the monthly report after confirmation
Research five public websites in parallel and summarize findings
description_zh: CDP 直连本地 Chrome，智能调度联网工具，支持登录态、并行批量操作
description_en: CDP-based web access: search, scrape, login-aware browsing, parallel ops
